scope: The sim -> paper -> live gate ladder for the selected destination (NautilusTrader 2.0.0rc5 with IBKR primary and a separate Alpaca paper adapter; LEAN 985ef30 frozen oracle). Each gate names the receipt that establishes it and the machine-checkable condition that flips it. scripts/trading_gates.py --check verifies the ladder arithmetically; a status changes only by a dated commit after the checker lists the gate as a flip candidate; an exists condition proves only that a non-empty file is present, so gates using it carry a presence-only limitation in their note. Rung readiness = every required gate of that rung and every earlier rung established. Nothing here authorizes live configuration, paid hosting or orders.

rung_meaning.sim: historical simulation qualified on the destination engine against the frozen oracle and clean data
rung_meaning.paper: paper operation qualified: broker path exercised, alerts wired, credentials handled, snapshots gated
rung_meaning.live: live entry prerequisites: paper leverage ladder, native fault behaviour, IBKR acceptance, explicit go

gates.title: Adaptive paper runtime completes a regular-session broker trial
gates.note: Current receipt: status local_integration_passed_new_broker_trial_pending, broker_readiness not_started (regular_session_window_unavailable). Synthetic capacity fixture (180 fills / 90 round trips in 60.42 s) used zero broker connections and is not this gate. Authorized paper work, not run by the 2026-09-22 handbook wave. 2026-09-22 10:55 ET: one SIP trial in the default state root ended completed_no_signals in 0.35 s with 0 orders and a flat reconciliation, which does not meet the flip condition. Root cause measured: the Windows host clock was +0.64 s off NTP and WSL's hv_utils time sync pulled the guest to it, so live quotes looked future-stamped and tripped the transport's -0.25 s quote guard (quote_timestamp_stale -> start_not_ready); an environment fault, not an engine or feed fault. Next attempt needs `w32tm /resync /force` on the host (user OS action) and, since PR-4, a passing promotion-gate result for the paper command (--gate-result/--snapshot). Ownership passed to peer:sota-workflow-resolution with adaptive-paper integration on 2026-09-22. 2026-09-23 (engine outputs and labelled operator observations in blueprints/us-equities/adaptive-paper/trials/20260923-interrupted/): the scheduled 10:05 ET timer for frozen 41d39b3 was stopped externally at 09:39:24 ET (actor unidentified); relaunched at 10:11:05 ET from the same frozen archive. Ingest 480 rows and the promotion gate passed, but the runner stopped after 4.15 s of 300 (3 warm-up decisions, regime unavailable, 8,512 native quotes, 0 orders, flat) and reported completed_no_signals. The log shows a trading-stream websocket restart message; corrected at 11:30 ET: that message is emitted when the engine closes its own streams at shutdown, not the cause (the transport alone stayed healthy for 25 s). A clock-offset check about 13 minutes later found 0.06 s against NTP (operator observation), so the 2026-09-22 clock fault is unlikely. An interrupted decision loop is needs_attention, not a trial; no retry of 41d39b3. 2026-09-23 11:27 ET second attempt (blueprints/us-equities/adaptive-paper/trials/20260923b-needs-attention/): from Codex's frozen stop-diagnostics build 1e2c96a, needs_attention after 25.9 s. Recorded: decision_exit transport_gap, callback_failure at stage quote_normalization (normalize_quote raised TransportError). Most likely a crossed SIP quote (bid above ask), the only rejection class in the committed quote-validity measurements; the same cause is the likely explanation of the 10:11 run, which recorded no stop reason. 11:42 and 11:5x ET runs from integration build 796e3d1 (1e2c96a plus the crossed-quote fix; trials/20260923c-reconcile-refusal/) reached the 30 s reconciliation and failed there: transport.mark_reconciled refused while any event was queued, and on SIP the quote queue is never empty (traceback retained). Fixed by dropping and counting well-formed crossed or one-sided quotes (halt-flagged, malformed or unsubscribed ones still fail closed) and refusing reconciliation only while an order event is queued. Gate unchanged until a trial completes. 11:54 ET run from integration build 885663a (both SIP fixes; trials/20260923e-first-roundtrip/): the first real engine round trip on the paper broker, INTC buy 1 filled 120.40 then recovery sell 1 filled 120.39, flat, net -0.01 USD; it stopped at 43.3 s with adapter_error because the fill TradeId (UUID + ':cum:' + qty, 42 characters) exceeds Nautilus's 36-character limit. Fixed with a deterministic 36-character digest. 11:59 ET: first PASSED 1x trial (trials/20260923f-first-passed/) from integration build 5e1d512 (1e2c96a plus all three #123 fixes): 300.1 s, duration_completed, 8 real paper orders and 8 native fills over four 1-share round trips (GOOGL, AAPL, AMZN, INTC), 13 crossed quotes dropped, reconciled flat with cash and positions matching, realized -0.29 USD; the broker readback matches. The gate stays not_established until 1e2c96a's commits and #123 are on main and a main-built trial passes, so the flip receipt binds to published code.

gates.title: Broker-state failure handling exercised against native (non-synthetic) faults
gates.note: Partial evidence, 2026-09-23 (status unchanged): blueprints/us-equities/adaptive-paper/native-faults/receipt.json, one live Alpaca paper run of the minimal harness at 14:20:24Z (status native_faults_incomplete). C01 accept resting buy and C02 cancel resting passed with native_paper evidence (submit 200 pending_new; cancel 204 canceled); C05 cancel again short-circuits in the engine without a DELETE (engine_short_circuit); C04 definitive rejection is unobserved because the Ledger refuses the sub-penny price before send (invalid_price_increment). Cleanup proved flat, 1 of 4 POSTs used. Reaching native_faults_passed needs an engine path that sends the C05 DELETE to the broker, and for C04 either an engine or plan change so a broker 422 on an invalid price counts as a definitive refusal (the Ledger accepts only 401, 403 and 404) or a fault Alpaca answers with 401, 403 or 404, besides sending the C04 order at all. The receipt is bound to the harness as run (harness_sha256 742fb666...); harness.py was hardened afterwards after review (cleanup exceptions still mark the run, an earlier IN_FLIGHT or CLEANUP_REQUIRED marker refuses a new start, the write-ahead marker is fsynced, a failed transport stop fails the run), so the next run binds a new hash. runtime-target.json next_acceptance broker-state-failures: bounded_alpaca_synthetic_cases_passed_native_faults_pending. Required receipt schema (preregistered before the first receipt, the 2026-09-23 native_faults_incomplete one, following the next_acceptance status-string convention already used in catalogs/us-equities/runtime-target.json): {"schema_version": 1, "kind": "native_fault_behaviour_receipt", "status": "native_faults_passed", "broker": "alpaca"}. The checker only verifies /status == "native_faults_passed"; that native (non-synthetic) faults were actually exercised, distinct from the 27 bounded synthetic cases already passed, is qualified manually before the dated commit that flips this gate.
